title: where do i have design system files ? all in one file or sep

messages.content: where do i have design system files ? all in one file or separate ?

Your design system is **split across 4 separate files** in `design/`, not one file. Each has a distinct job:

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `design/tokens.css` | **Source of truth** — CSS variables (colors, spacing, etc.). Never hard-code; reference this. |
| `design/Styles.txt` | Plain-text reference of the same values (for quick lookup / pasting into Bubble). |
| `design/design.md` | The **rules and reasoning** — why tokens are what they are, section structure, conventions. |
| `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html` | Rendered UI kit / visual component reference. |

There's also a brain pointer at `brain/design.md`, but it's just a redirect — it says the real source lives in `design/tokens.css` + `design/design.md`, so it never duplicates them.

**Rule of thumb:** change a value → edit `design/tokens.css` (and mirror in `Styles.txt`); change a rule/rationale → edit `design/design.md`.
